title: OSERO token emissions beyond the Genesis Supply are permanently disabled and Osero Governance cannot reverse it
content:
A.6.1.1.7.2.1.4.2.1.1.6 states that "token emissions beyond the Genesis Supply are permanently disabled; this cannot be reverted by Osero Governance."

The second clause is the whole content of the decision. A supply cap that the issuer's own governance can lift is a policy; one that its governance is structurally barred from lifting is a commitment. By putting the restriction beyond Osero Governance's reach, the Artifact removes inflation as an instrument the Agent could use to fund operations, reward insiders, or paper over losses — and removes the ongoing political fight over whether to use it.

The cost is loss of a legitimate tool. An Agent facing an unforeseen capital need cannot mint its way out, so it must raise, earn, or shrink. That is the intended trade: predictable supply for OSERO holders in exchange for the Agent's own financial flexibility.

The commitment is also what makes the single exception in the same section meaningful — because Osero can never re-enable emissions itself, the reserved Sky Governance override is the only path, and therefore an unambiguous statement about who ranks above whom.
description: A hard supply commitment enforced against the Agent's own governance, removing dilution as a lever Osero could reach for under pressure or to fund itself.
